changeSet.author: claude (P4-06)
changeSet.comment: Language codes are stored uppercase from P4-06 on, so the browse language filter is a plain indexed equality. ms_dictionary validates codes case-insensitively but stores them as the client sent them, and dev data is lowercase; the consumers now uppercase on write, and this brings rows written before that into line. Not reversible - the original casing is not recorded - so the rollback is empty on purpose: rolling back the code leaves uppercase data, which the old code reads fine.

sql.sql: UPDATE dictionary_stats SET from_lang = UPPER(from_lang), to_lang = UPPER(to_lang) WHERE from_lang <> UPPER(from_lang) OR to_lang <> UPPER(to_lang);
